ValidationRule.description: For Sales Offer Bespoke Incentive, Campaign Start Date >= 6 weeks from Created Date and Survey, Campaign Start Date >= 2 weeks
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ NOT ( $UserRole.Id = $Label.QF_Support_QIC_Member), /*QF-Support-Agency Support-QAC*/ NOT ( CONTAINS ( $User.Level__c , "SO(SME)")),
OR ( AND( ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Bespoke Incentive") , OR( Campaign_Start_Date__c = TODAY() , Campaign_Start_Date__c - TODAY() < 42 ) ),
AND( ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Survey") , OR( Campaign_Start_Date__c = TODAY() , Campaign_Start_Date__c - TODAY() < 14 ) ))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Bespoke Incentive Type, Campaign Start Date > 6 weeks. For Survey Type, Campaign Start Date > 2 weeks.
